sample.rules_primary: If there is at least 6 or more consecutive days within September 14, 2026 through September 20, 2026 on which the daily average temperature at KIAH in Houston is strictly greater than 90 degrees Fahrenheit, then the market resolves to Yes.
sample.rules_secondary:
Data for KIAH is available at https://weather.com/kalshi. A day's average temperature is the arithmetic mean of the hourly temperature values reported by The Weather Company for KIAH from 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM local time, rounded to the nearest whole degree. Data as published at the Expiration Time will be used; later revisions are disregarded.

An average of exactly 90 degrees Fahrenheit does not satisfy the condition. Only days within September 14, 2026 through September 20, 2026 may count toward a streak. A day with fewer than 18 reported hourly values does not satisfy the condition and breaks a streak.
sample.title: Will the average temperature in Houston be above 90°F for 6 or more consecutive days in the week of Sep 14, 2026?
